title: Abekyo Project
description: A complete Abekyo Editor project: the exact JSON accepted by POST /api/render and POST /api/project/validate. Generate this from any program or LLM, then POST it to a running Abekyo server to get an MP4 back.

clips.description: Ordered timeline of scenes. Each clip shows an image or video, optionally with narration audio. Clips play back-to-back; total video length is the sum of clip durations.

subtitles.description: Time-based subtitle overlays. Times are absolute seconds from the start of the video, independent of clip boundaries.

bgmUrl.description: Background-music audio URL. Same-origin path (e.g. /uploads/audio/track.mp3, as returned by POST /api/upload) or an absolute URL on a host listed in RENDER_ALLOWED_MEDIA_HOSTS.

bgmStartTime.description: Seconds to skip from the start of the BGM file (trim-in point).

bgmEndTime.description: Position in the BGM file where playback stops, in seconds. null plays to the end.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier. Combined with aspectRatio to pick pixel dimensions (e.g. 1080p + 16:9 = 1920x1080).

aspectRatio.description: Output aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape, 9:16 vertical (Shorts/Reels/TikTok), 1:1 square.

productName.description: Optional project title. Not rendered into the video; used for metadata.

audioEnabled.description: Master audio switch. false renders a silent video.

mediaUrl.description: Same-origin path (/uploads/...) or an absolute http(s) URL on an allowed host.

plotName.description: Human-readable scene name shown in the editor timeline.

text.description: Scene script / narration text. Informational; not rendered on screen (use subtitles for on-screen text).

imageUrl.description: Image (jpg/png/gif/webp) or video (mp4/mov/webm) shown for this clip. null renders a black frame.

audioUrl.description: Narration audio for this clip. Empty string means no narration.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds. Defaults to 3 when omitted. Puxin narration defaults to natural 1.0x playback, so a narrated clip can follow the source audio duration directly. Deployments cap per-clip and total duration (defaults: 300s per clip, 1800s total).

index.description: Zero-based position in the clips array. Must equal the clip's array position.

totalClips.description: Total number of clips. Optional; informational.

imageEffect.description: Motion effect applied to the clip's image.

audioStartTime.description: Seconds to skip from the start of audioUrl (trim-in point), measured in the audio file's own timebase.

transitionType.description: Transition into this clip from the previous one.

position.description: Image offset in percent of frame size.

sceneLayout.description: Visual composition mode. fit-blur preserves the full source over a blurred full-frame copy, useful for vertical video.

showSceneSubtitle.description: Whether clip.text is rendered as an extra subtitle. Set false when the source artwork already contains text.

id.description: Unique subtitle id (any unique string; the editor uses timestamps). Recommended so the editor can address each subtitle.

text.description: Text shown on screen. \n breaks lines.

startTime.description: When the subtitle appears, in seconds from video start.

endTime.description: When the subtitle disappears, in seconds. Must not be before startTime.

position.description: Coarse vertical anchor. Overridden by positionYPercent when set.

fontSize.description: Font size as percent of frame height (5 = 5%).

fontSizePercent.description: Preferred over fontSize when present. Same unit.

backgroundColor.description: CSS background color behind the text. Omit for none.

positionYPercent.description: Vertical position, percent of frame height from the top (10 = 10% down).

positionXPercent.description: Horizontal position, percent of frame width from the left.
